$comment: Architecture roadmap for the AI-engine rebuild of the Go control plane (backend/). Model identifiers verified against the official Cloudflare Workers AI model catalog (developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/). Skill prompts live in backend/skills/ and are injected verbatim as the system message of the matching model.
name: vibesdk-go-ai-engine

env.AI_GATEWAY_URL: AI Gateway base URL; when empty the client falls back to the Workers AI endpoint above (see backend/pkg/llm/client.go)
env.AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY: static Cloudflare API token with Workers AI (+ AI Gateway) permissions; never the short-lived wrangler OAuth token
env.DEFAULT_MODEL: default chat model id; docker-compose.yml defaults it to @cf/qwen/qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct

streaming.tolerance: malformed chunks (numeric content deltas from Workers AI) are tolerated upstream by the tolerant model wrapper

planner.output: strict JSON plan: thought_process (CoT) + subtasks + executable steps
planner.notes: Analyzes the current VFS first; CoT and subtasks are mandatory before any file is planned; the entire response must be one raw JSON object.

coder.output: raw file content only (no markdown fences, no prose, no placeholders)
coder.notes: One file task per call; emits the complete production-ready content of the requested file.

stages.name: vfs_snapshot
stages.component: ProjectRoom VFS (Redis hash vfs:{chatId}) passed to the planner as the current state

stages.name: generate
stages.writes: vfs_write tool -> file_generating / file_generated WS events

pipeline.fallback: single-model fence-streaming path (backend/pkg/engine/prompts.go + runGeneration in room.go)

phases.title: Skill prompts extracted to backend/skills/
phases.acceptance: Planner prompt mandates VFS analysis -> thought_process -> subtasks -> steps with JSON-only output; Coder prompt forbids fences and prose.

phases.title: Model registry + skills loader in Go (load .md system prompt per role)
phases.acceptance: go vet ./... && go test ./... green; prompts loaded from backend/skills/ at startup with a clear error if a skill file is missing; SKILLS_DIR pins the directory (container path /app/skills).

phases.title: Wire the dual-model pipeline: planner JSON -> per-step coder calls with vfs_write
phases.acceptance: A greenfield fixture produces a working static app end-to-end; plan approval gate still enforced.

phases.title: AI Gateway observability and per-role settings (caching / rate limiting / logs)
phases.acceptance: Gateway logs distinguish planner vs coder requests; rate limits applied per role.
